cases.question: List all suppliers in the supply network.

plan.cypher: MATCH (o:Organization) WHERE o.kind = 'supplier' AND (toLower(o.name) CONTAINS toLower($search) OR o.id = $search) RETURN o.id AS id, o.name AS name, o.provenance AS provenance ORDER BY o.id LIMIT $limit

cases.summary: Returned 4 graph records for suppliers. See query evidence.

cases.question: What happens if Atlas Textiles (SUP-01) shuts down?

plan.cypher: MATCH p=(s:Organization {id: $supplier_id})-[:FLOW*1..6]->(o:Organization) WHERE length(p) <= $depth WITH o, min(length(p)) AS hops RETURN o.id AS id, o.name AS name, o.kind AS kind, hops ORDER BY hops, id LIMIT $limit

cases.summary: 40 products lose delivery capacity; 112.2 units/day of demand are unmet. Backup contracts can restore 60.3 units/day. These are scenario estimates based on assumed supply lanes.

cases.question: Show the supply provenance for product SKU-1360.

plan.cypher: MATCH (l:Lane)-[:CARRIES]->(p:Product {id: $sku}) MATCH (l)-[:ORIGIN]->(a:Organization), (l)-[:DESTINATION]->(b:Organization) RETURN l.id AS id, a.id AS origin, b.id AS destination, p.id AS sku, l.capacity AS capacity, l.lead_days AS lead_days, l.backup AS backup, l.provenance AS provenance ORDER BY l.id LIMIT $limit

cases.summary: Returned 8 graph records for provenance. See query evidence.

cases.question: Which products have only one primary supplier?

plan.cypher: MATCH (s:Organization)-[:ORIGIN]-(l:Lane)-[:CARRIES]->(p:Product) WHERE s.kind = 'supplier' AND l.backup = false WITH p, collect(DISTINCT s.id) AS suppliers WHERE size(suppliers) = 1 RETURN p.id AS sku, p.name AS name, suppliers[0] AS supplier_id, p.daily_demand AS daily_demand ORDER BY daily_demand DESC, sku LIMIT $limit
